data.name: WREKD
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to WREKD — a chaotic, couch-friendly, friendship-destroying bumper car party game where physics is optional and flying is guaranteed.

WREKD is a fast-paced co-op and multiplayer arcade game where tiny cars cause huge problems. Smash your friends, launch your enemies, steal goals, win races, and turn every arena into a metal scrapyard of screams and laughter.

Whether you’re flipping rivals into the sky in Deathmatch, drifting like a maniac in Races, or committing vehicular football crimes in Car Football, one thing is always true:

👉 Someone is getting WREKD.

🚗 Deathmatch

Hit opponents from the side to launch them into the air, send them flying off the map, and rack up points. If they’re not airborne, you’re doing it wrong.

🏁 Race

Boost, bump, shortcut, and sabotage your way to the finish line. Winning is good. Making everyone else lose is better.

⚽ Football (with cars, obviously)

Goals, explosions, accidental own-goals, and absolutely zero respect for traffic laws.

Features

  • 🔥 Local & online co-op / multiplayer chaos

  • 🎮 Easy to play, hard to stay alive

  • 💥 Physics-based hits, boosts, jumps, and ridiculous crashes

  • 🏟️ Multiple arenas and modes with different twists

  • 😂 Built for laughs, rivalries, and “one more match” syndrome

WREKD is not about driving perfectly.
It’s about hitting first, flying far, and laughing the loudest.

So grab your friends.
Start your engines.
And get absolutely WREKD. 💥

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD R7 360 / Intel Iris Xe
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
